captions.detailed: This 3D model is a rectangular storage drawer designed for a rack system. It features an open-top box geometry with thin, uniform walls and a flat base. On the front exterior face, there is a small, semi-circular finger pull tab sticking out at the bottom to assist in sliding the drawer. Inside the drawer, vertical slots are molded into the side walls to allow a divider panel to be slid in.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric storage drawer for a rack system in OpenSCAD. The script should allow customization of the depth, height (via predefined box types: half-height, standard, double, and quad), inclusion of interior divider slots, and an option to render either the full box drawer or just the divider panel.
captions.factory: The script uses conditional blocks (`if`) based on `box_type` (0 to 3) and `panel` (0 or 1). For the main drawer (`panel == 0`), it constructs the outer box using a `difference` of two `cube` primitives to hollow it out. A finger pull is created at the front using a `difference` between a `cylinder` and a `cube`. If `divider == 1` is enabled, internal vertical slots are added along the side walls using a `difference` of nested `cube` shapes. When `panel == 1` is selected, it renders a single thin flat `cube` representing the divider insert.
